remarks: Experience sweeping views in this bright, spacious, immaculate 3-bedroom flat with amazing sunsets & 8th floor city views. It's in an elegant high rise building with deluxe amenities, including 24-hr front door concierge/security, 2-workout centers, library-community room, and refreshing pool. The apartment features sun-filled rooms, screened-in balcony, gleaming floors, great storage, in-unit washer & dryer, plus individual heating & cooling in each room. Entry foyer has double coat closet & leads to grand-sized Living room/Dining room w/excellent design for living & entertaining. LR flows into breakfast rm off the Kitchen, where there are sliders to delightful screened-in balcony, perfect spot for relaxing w/morning coffee or evening glass of wine while savoring the view w/family & friends. Fully equipped kitchen has abundant freshly painted cabinets, & even has an area w/butcher block countertop sure to please home chefs. Primary suite bedroom is very large w/double aspect panoramic views & custom-outfitted WI closet. Marble Primary bath completes the suite. There are 2-add'l sunny bedrooms, each w/outfitted closet, and a luxurious marble hall bath. You'll really enjoy the great location - walk to shops, movies and restaurants; it's even on a bus line to Metro North. Offering perfect space & location - it's YOUR time for the good life in an easy-living condominium w/fine amenities. Welcome Home!
